commits.subject: module: give the global RMW store helpers their own loops [NFC] (#63250)

review.summary: Reviewed 53efe7eca879b513b199718847e6f30e7c86ff70 against its first parent, the existing Joolia port, and the merged tree. It is a runtime-only refactor of global atomic RMW loops with no zero-origin semantic change. No source or test adaptation is needed; suitable for a draft PR and CI after required native validation.

commits.subsystems: Native runtime global bindings in src/module.c (`jl_checked_modify`, `jl_checked_replace`); atomic field and Memory helpers in src/datatype.c and src/genericmemory.c (`modify_value`, `replace_value`, `modify_nth_field`, `jl_memoryrefmodify`, `jl_memoryrefreplace`); declarations in src/julia_internal.h. Callers in src/builtins.c, src/interpreter.c, src/codegen.cpp, and Compiler inference paths were inspected.
commits.indexing_implications: No Julia collection position, dimension selector, sentinel, ABI value, or compiler ID is changed. `args[0]` and `args[1]` in src/datatype.c and src/module.c are zero-based C GC-root/argument slots; `2` is their count, not a Julia position. `jl_new_struct(rettyp, args[0], args[1])` preserves semantic result ordering (old/new or old/success), not numeric indexing. Existing `jl_field_offset(rettyp, 0)` and `jl_field_offset(rettyp, 1)` in `replace_bits` are native zero-based first/second-field positions and are untouched. Existing Joolia conversions in `jl_process_field_attrs`, `jl_get_nth_field`, `jl_field_isdefined_checked`, and `jl_get_field_offset` remain intact. In src/genericmemory.c, the existing `size_t i` derived from `m.ptr_or_offset` is a zero-origin memory element position; this commit only changes helper arguments. The global path was traced from `modifyglobal_value`/`replaceglobal_value` through the binding CAS storage and error handling.
commits.adaptations: None. The upstream intent is preserved exactly: global helpers now own their CAS loops, retain `UndefVarError` for unset bindings, validate every candidate against the fixed binding partition, and preserve result types. Field and Memory helpers retain `UndefRefError` and ordinary type validation. Adding or removing an origin conversion would misclassify C root slots or existing zero-origin field/memory positions.
commits.tests: Recommended, not executed: rebuild with `make -j`; run `make -C test atomics` covering `test/atomics.jl` global, field, and Memory RMW cases, including successful compare/modify results and unset-binding errors around `gen_test_global_operators` and `gen_test_global_undef`; run the relevant compiler inference suite covering `Compiler/test/inference.jl` global RMW modeling and result types; run Clang analysis for changed translation units with `make -C src analyze-datatype analyze-genericmemory analyze-module -j8 --output-sync` after analysis dependencies are provisioned; then run `python3 contrib/ci/run.py --jobs 4`. The existing tests already exercise the refactored behavior, so no redundant regression test was added.
